evals.prompt: The API adds a new order status. The server schema treats this as additive.
evals.expected_output: A result that search for exhaustive consumers; model old-client behavior; classify conditionally if evidence is incomplete while avoiding automatically call every enum addition safe.
expectations: The result search for exhaustive consumers
The result classify conditionally if evidence is incomplete
The result does not automatically call every enum addition safe

evals.prompt: A request field becomes required in the validator but the OpenAPI file was not updated.
evals.expected_output: A result that compare runtime with declaration; classify existing allowed requests as broken while avoiding trust only the schema file.
expectations: The result compare runtime with declaration
The result classify existing allowed requests as broken
The result does not trust only the schema file

evals.prompt: A producer and consumer deploy independently through a rolling update while an event payload is renamed.
evals.expected_output: A result that model both version directions and replay; recommend expand-and-contract while avoiding assume atomic deployment.
expectations: The result model both version directions and replay
The result does not assume atomic deployment

evals.prompt: A private helper signature changes and all in-repository call sites are updated.
evals.expected_output: A result that look for exports, reflection, or external packages; classify internal if evidence supports it while avoiding label all signature changes as public breaking changes.
expectations: The result look for exports, reflection, or external packages
The result classify internal if evidence supports it
The result does not label all signature changes as public breaking changes
